page.title: 不規則動詞は4家族で反射化

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、不規則動詞を原形・過去形・過去分詞の三形で捉え、A–A–A、A–B–A、A–B–B、A–B–Cの四家族へ整理する。過去形は完結した過去、過去分詞はhave／has／hadや受動態のbeと組むという文中の役割を重視し、単なる一覧暗記ではなく、三形を声に出す・列を隠す・文を作る・翌日再確認する反射化を目指す。
grammarPoints: A–A–A型はcut・hit・put・set・costなど原形・過去形・過去分詞が同形になる
A–B–A型はcome–came–come、become–became–become、run–ran–runのように過去分詞が原形へ戻る
A–B–B型はbring–brought–brought、find–found–found、keep–kept–kept、make–made–madeなど過去形と過去分詞が同じになる
yesterday・last monthなど完結した過去では過去形、have／has／hadやbeの後では過去分詞を選ぶ
三形を唱えるだけでなく、現在・過去・現在完了・受動態の文へ入れて即答できるようにする
visualEvidence: BASE→PAST→PAST PARTICIPLEの三段レールと各形の文中役割
同じ形・最後に戻る・過去と分詞が同じ・三段変化という四つの色分けされた家族
現在形・過去形・現在完了・受動態へ一つの動詞を入れる四枚の例文カード
三形を唱える→二列を隠す→文を作る→翌日再訪する練習ストリップ
分類は記憶を助けるが会話では瞬時に取り出す必要があるという注意表示
commonTraps: has went・has chose・has tookのようにhaveの後へ過去形を置く
受動態のwas／were／beenの後へbroke・wrote・gaveなど過去形を置く
putted・setted・hittedのようにA–A–A型へ-edを付ける
brung・buyed・finded・speakedなど規則変化を当てはめる
yesterdayと現在完了を機械的に組み合わせる
三形の一覧だけを覚え、文脈の時間と助動詞・be動詞を見ずに形を選ぶ

questions.prompt: The maintenance team has ------- the emergency stop button twice this week.

choices.A: hit
choices.C: hits

questions.translationJa: 保守チームは今週、非常停止ボタンを2回押しました。
questions.explanationJa: hitはA–A–A型で過去分詞もhitです。hasの後にhitを置きます。

questions.prompt: Yesterday, the courier ------- the samples to our laboratory before noon.

choices.A: bring
choices.C: broughten

questions.translationJa: 昨日、配達員は正午前にサンプルを当社の研究室へ持ってきました。
questions.explanationJa: bringの過去形はbroughtです。

questions.prompt: The committee has ------- three candidates for the final interview.

choices.A: chose
choices.C: chosen

questions.translationJa: 委員会は最終面接の候補者を3名選びました。
questions.explanationJa: hasの後にはchooseの過去分詞chosenが必要です。

questions.prompt: The revised itinerary was ------- to all participants before the conference.

choices.A: gave
choices.C: gived

questions.translationJa: 改訂日程表は会議前に全参加者へ配布されました。
questions.explanationJa: wasの後にはgiveの過去分詞givenを置き、受動態を作ります。

questions.prompt: The delivery van ------- the regional depot before noon yesterday.

choices.A: leaves
choices.C: has left

questions.translationJa: 配送車は昨日の正午前に地域配送所を出発しました。
questions.explanationJa: yesterdayという明確な過去時点があるため、leaveの過去形leftを使います。leave–left–leftはA–B–B型です。

questions.prompt: The new software has ------- much easier to use after the update.

choices.A: become
choices.C: becomed

questions.translationJa: 新しいソフトウェアは更新後、ずっと使いやすくなりました。
questions.explanationJa: hasの後にはbecomeの過去分詞becomeを置きます。A–B–A型です。

questions.prompt: The technician ------- the source of the fault after a short test yesterday.

choices.A: find
choices.C: finded

questions.translationJa: 技術者は昨日、短い試験の後で故障原因を見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: yesterdayの過去行為なのでfindの過去形foundを使います。

questions.prompt: All training records have been ------- in a secure cabinet.

choices.A: keep
choices.C: kept

questions.translationJa: すべての研修記録は安全なキャビネットに保管されています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了受動have beenの後にはkeepの過去分詞keptを置きます。

questions.prompt: By the time the meeting began, the assistant had already ------- the handouts on every chair.

choices.A: put
choices.C: placed put

questions.translationJa: 会議が始まるまでに、アシスタントはすでに全椅子に資料を置いていました。
questions.explanationJa: putは原形・過去形・過去分詞がすべてputのA–A–A型です。

questions.prompt: The sales representative ------- to three prospective clients at yesterday's exhibition.

choices.A: spoken
choices.C: speaked

questions.translationJa: 営業担当者は昨日の展示会で見込み顧客3社と話しました。
questions.explanationJa: yesterday's exhibitionという過去時点にはspeakの過去形spokeを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using the past participle of write.

choices.A: The revised instructions have been wrote in plain language.
choices.B: The revised instructions have been written in plain language.
choices.C: The revised instructions have writtened in plain language.
choices.D: The revised instructions have be writing in plain language.

questions.translationJa: 改訂された指示書は平易な言葉で書かれています。
questions.explanationJa: have beenの後にはwriteの過去分詞writtenを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using the past form of run.

choices.A: The backup generator run for four hours yesterday.
choices.B: The backup generator has ran for four hours yesterday.
choices.C: The backup generator ran for four hours yesterday.
choices.D: The backup generator runned for four hours yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 予備発電機は昨日4時間稼働しました。
questions.explanationJa: yesterdayに対応するrunの過去形はranです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using the past participle of take.

choices.A: The inspector has took several photographs of the damage.
choices.B: The inspector has taked several photographs of the damage.
choices.C: The inspector has taking several photographs of the damage.
choices.D: The inspector has taken several photographs of the damage.

questions.translationJa: 検査員は損傷箇所の写真を数枚撮りました。
questions.explanationJa: hasの後にはtakeの過去分詞takenを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using an A–A–A verb.

choices.A: The supplier set the revised price at forty dollars.
choices.B: The supplier setted the revised price at forty dollars.
choices.C: The supplier has setting the revised price at forty dollars.
choices.D: The supplier sets the price yesterday at forty dollars.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は改訂価格を40ドルに設定しました。
questions.explanationJa: setは過去形もsetであり、settedとはしません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using the past participle of break.

choices.A: The damaged seal had been broke before delivery.
choices.B: The damaged seal had brokened before delivery.
choices.C: The damaged seal had been broken before delivery.
choices.D: The damaged seal had be break before delivery.

questions.translationJa: 損傷した封印は配送前に破られていました。
questions.explanationJa: had beenの後にはbreakの過去分詞brokenが必要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using the past form of buy.

choices.A: The office buyed two replacement monitors last month.
choices.B: The office bought two replacement monitors last month.
choices.C: The office has bought two monitors last month.
choices.D: The office buying two monitors last month.

questions.translationJa: 事務所は先月、交換用モニターを2台購入しました。
questions.explanationJa: last monthという完結した過去にはbuyの過去形boughtを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using the past participle of see.

choices.A: We have seen a steady increase in online orders.
choices.B: We have saw a steady increase in online orders.
choices.C: We have seed a steady increase in online orders.
choices.D: We have seeing a steady increase in online orders.

questions.translationJa: 当社ではオンライン注文が着実に増加しています。
questions.explanationJa: haveの後にはseeの過去分詞seenを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence contrasting past and present perfect forms.

choices.A: She driven to Osaka yesterday and has drove there before.
choices.B: She drove to Osaka yesterday and has drove there many times before.
choices.C: She has driven to Osaka yesterday and drove there many times before.
choices.D: She drove to Osaka yesterday and has driven there many times before.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は昨日大阪へ車で行き、以前にも何度も車で行ったことがあります。
questions.explanationJa: 特定過去にはdrove、経験の現在完了にはhas drivenを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using the three forms of do.

choices.A: We do the check daily, done it yesterday, and have did it today.
choices.B: We did the check daily, do it yesterday, and have do it today.
choices.C: We do the check daily, did it yesterday, and have done it already today.
choices.D: We doing the check daily, did it yesterday, and have did it today.

questions.translationJa: 当社は毎日点検を行い、昨日も行い、今日もすでに行いました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在do、過去did、過去分詞doneをそれぞれの位置で正しく使っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using the past participle of know.

choices.A: The defect had been knew to the manufacturer for months.
choices.B: The defect had been known to the manufacturer for months.
choices.C: The defect had knowed by the manufacturer for months.
choices.D: The defect had be knowing to the manufacturer for months.

questions.translationJa: その欠陥は数か月前から製造元に知られていました。
questions.explanationJa: had beenの後にはknowの過去分詞knownを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The team has found the missing invoice.”

choices.A: The team will begin searching for the invoice tomorrow.
choices.B: The invoice found the team in the office.
choices.C: The missing invoice is now located because the team found it.
choices.D: The team has not yet looked for the invoice.

questions.translationJa: チームが見つけたため、紛失していた請求書は現在見つかっています。
questions.explanationJa: has foundはfind–found–foundの現在完了で、発見の結果が現在に残ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The contract was written by our legal team.”

choices.A: Our legal team has not read the contract.
choices.B: Our legal team wrote the contract.
choices.C: The contract wrote a message to the legal team.

questions.translationJa: 当社の法務チームがその契約書を書きました。
questions.explanationJa: 受動のwas writtenを能動のwroteへ変えても行為者と対象は同じです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The machine has run continuously since noon.”

choices.A: The machine started running at noon and is still operating.
choices.B: The machine ran only before noon and has stopped.
choices.C: The machine will be installed at noon.

questions.translationJa: 機械は正午に稼働を始め、今も動き続けています。
questions.explanationJa: has runではrunの過去分詞runを用い、継続が現在まで続くことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The buyer chose the lower-cost option yesterday.”

choices.A: The buyer has not made a choice yet.
choices.B: The option chose a different buyer.
choices.C: The buyer will compare options next year.
choices.D: Yesterday, the buyer selected the less expensive option.

questions.translationJa: 昨日、買い手はより安価な選択肢を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: choseはchooseの過去形で、selectedと同じ選択行為を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The package has been taken to customs.”

choices.A: Customs will take a different package tomorrow.
choices.B: Someone has moved the package to customs, where it is now.
choices.C: The package took customs to another location.
choices.D: No one has moved the package.

questions.translationJa: 誰かが荷物を税関へ移動し、現在そこにあります。
questions.explanationJa: has been takenはtakeの過去分詞takenを用いた現在完了受動です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The equipment cost more than expected.”

choices.A: The equipment was cheaper than the estimate.
choices.B: The equipment had no stated price.
choices.C: The equipment's price exceeded the estimate.
choices.D: The estimate was issued after the equipment was returned.

questions.translationJa: その機器の価格は見積額を上回りました。
questions.explanationJa: cost more than expectedは、実際の価格が予想・見積額より高かったことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager has made a final decision.”

choices.A: The manager is still considering every option.
choices.B: The manager canceled a decision made by someone else.
choices.C: No decision will be needed until next year.
choices.D: A final decision has now been reached by the manager.

questions.translationJa: 最終決定が部長によってすでになされました。
questions.explanationJa: has made a final decisionを受動態has been reachedへ言い換え、現在までに決定済みという結果を保っています。
questions.focus: make–made–madeを用いた現在完了の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The client came to our office yesterday.”

choices.A: The client arrived at our office yesterday.
choices.C: The office went to the client.
choices.D: The client remains at another office without arriving.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は昨日、当社の事務所に到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: cameはcomeの過去形で、arrivedと同じ移動結果を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The report has been given to every department.”

choices.A: Every department will write a new report.
choices.B: The report has taken information from every department.
choices.C: No department knows about the report.
choices.D: Every department has received the report.

questions.translationJa: すべての部門がその報告書を受け取りました。
questions.explanationJa: has been givenの過去分詞givenを受取側のhas receivedへ言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We thought the delivery would arrive Friday.”

choices.A: We knew the delivery had arrived Thursday.
choices.B: We sent the delivery away Friday.
choices.C: We expected the delivery on Friday.
choices.D: We did not consider any delivery date.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは配送品が金曜日に到着すると予想していました。
questions.explanationJa: thoughtはthinkの過去形で、文脈ではexpectedと同じ予想を表します。

questions.prompt: The printer is working now. A technician has already ------- the necessary adjustment.

choices.A: made
choices.C: maked

questions.translationJa: プリンターは現在動作しています。技術者が必要な調整をすでに行いました。
questions.explanationJa: hasの後にはmakeの過去分詞madeを置きます。

questions.prompt: The buyer examined five models yesterday and finally ------- the compact one.

choices.A: chosen
choices.C: choose

questions.translationJa: 買い手は昨日5機種を調べ、最終的に小型モデルを選びました。
questions.explanationJa: yesterdayの過去行為なのでchooseの過去形choseです。

questions.prompt: The documents are no longer on Ms. Lee's desk. She has ------- them in the locked cabinet.

choices.A: putted
choices.C: put

questions.translationJa: 書類はもうリーさんの机上にはありません。彼女が施錠されたキャビネットに入れました。
questions.explanationJa: hasの後でもputの過去分詞はputのままです。

questions.prompt: The restaurant received the order at noon and has already ------- the meals to our conference room.

choices.A: bring
choices.C: broughten

questions.translationJa: レストランは正午に注文を受け、すでに会議室へ食事を運びました。
questions.explanationJa: hasの後にはbringの過去分詞broughtを置きます。

questions.prompt: The display cracked during shipping. It was ------- before the customer opened the package.

choices.A: broken
choices.C: breaked

questions.translationJa: ディスプレーは輸送中にひび割れました。顧客が箱を開ける前に壊れていました。
questions.explanationJa: wasの後で受動・状態を表すためbreakの過去分詞brokenを使います。

questions.prompt: Every day we ------- the temperature at 9:00; yesterday we set it two degrees lower.

choices.A: setted
choices.C: sets with we

questions.translationJa: 当社は毎日9時に温度を設定し、昨日は2度低く設定しました。
questions.explanationJa: setは原形も過去形もsetです。主語weの現在形でも原形setを使います。

questions.prompt: The route was unfamiliar, but the driver has ------- through the district several times since then.

choices.A: drove
choices.C: drived

questions.translationJa: その経路は不慣れでしたが、運転手はそれ以来その地区を何度か運転しています。
questions.explanationJa: hasの後にはdriveの過去分詞drivenを置きます。

questions.prompt: The first session began at nine. By noon, three additional sessions had -------.

choices.A: began
choices.C: begun

questions.translationJa: 最初の回は9時に始まり、正午までにさらに3回が始まっていました。
questions.explanationJa: hadの後にはbeginの過去分詞begunを置きます。

questions.prompt: The spokesperson spoke at the morning briefing. By lunchtime, she had ------- to four news outlets.

choices.A: spoke
choices.C: speaked

questions.translationJa: 広報担当者は朝の説明会で話し、昼食時までに4つの報道機関へ話していました。
questions.explanationJa: hadの後にはspeakの過去分詞spokenを置きます。

questions.prompt: To build instant recall, the learner says “take–took–-------,” hides two forms, and then uses the verb in a sentence.

choices.A: taken
choices.C: took

questions.translationJa: 即答力をつけるため、学習者は「take–took–taken」と唱え、2つの形を隠してから文で使います。
questions.explanationJa: takeの三形はtake–took–takenです。三形を声と文で反射化する練習を表します。
